summary: Neo spins away and turns, finding himself in an open market teeming with people. He careens uncontrollably down the little avenues lined with vendors and shops, weaving through the labyrinth. At every turn an Agent appears—emerging from dense crowds, behind fish stalls, tent flaps, and stacked crates—so the market becomes a trap ringed with pursuers rather than an escape.
